# NextPage Addons

> Community directory of book catalogs (addons) for NextPage. Search, filter, and open any addon for details.

## Routes

ES (default locale, no prefix):

- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/enviar
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/docs

- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/gutendex
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/openlibrary

EN (under /en/):

- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/en/
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/en/catalog
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/en/submit
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/en/docs

- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/en/catalog/gutendex
- https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/en/catalog/openlibrary

## Catalog

Complete machine-readable catalog: https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalog.json

- Gutendex — Over 70,000 free ebooks from Project Gutenberg, with search and full details. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/gutendex
- Open Library — Millions of records and covers from the Internet Archive open library. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/openlibrary

## Contribute

Propose a new addon at https://github.com/JuanCamacho198/NEXTPAGE (see the submit page).
